page.title: Digital brand
page.description: Live website audit plus SEO, performance, trust and channel recommendations.

smartBar.title: Digital brand audits your website live — SEO, performance and trust with concrete recommendations.
smartBar.step2: Run audit and review PageSpeed and HTML values
smartBar.step3: Prioritize high recommendations under the Recommendations tab
smartBar.tip: The audit runs server-side — no code needs to be installed on the site.
smartBar.liveHintNoWebsite: Add website URL under Company to run an audit.
smartBar.liveHintOk: Audit looks good — no critical issues right now.

alerts.noWebsiteDescSuffix: to run a Digital Brand audit.

research.mcpDescription: SEO overview and domain lookup for your registered website.

overview.auditLoading: Running PageSpeed Insights and fetching HTML, robots.txt and sitemap.xml…
overview.auditIdle: Run an audit to fetch live SEO and performance values from the website.

metrics.mobilePageSpeedHint: Lighthouse performance score from PageSpeed Insights.
metrics.mobileSeoHint: Lighthouse SEO score from PageSpeed Insights.
metrics.responseTimeHint: Measured by the server-side audit fetch.
metrics.desktopPageSpeedHint: Lighthouse performance score (desktop) from PageSpeed Insights.
metrics.imagesMissingAltHint: Based on img tags in fetched HTML.

registerWebsite.title: Register your primary website
registerWebsite.detail: Add the website URL under {{connections}} before running a Digital Brand audit.

pageSpeedScore.title: PageSpeed performance score
pageSpeedScore.detailMobileDesktop: Mobile Lighthouse performance is {{mobileScore}}. Desktop is {{desktopScore}}.

pageSpeedUnavailable.title: PageSpeed Insights unavailable
pageSpeedUnavailable.detailFallback: Add PAGESPEED_API_KEY or GOOGLE_PAGESPEED_API_KEY for Lighthouse values.

lighthouseSeoScore.title: Lighthouse SEO score
lighthouseSeoScore.detail: This is the Lighthouse SEO category score from PageSpeed Insights for the registered URL.

accessibilityScore.title: Accessibility score
accessibilityScore.detail: Accessibility issues often affect conversion, usability and perceived brand quality.

bestPracticesScore.title: Best practices score
bestPracticesScore.detail: Lighthouse best practices checks security, browser compatibility and implementation quality.

lcp.title: Largest Contentful Paint
lcp.detail: LCP measures how fast main content loads. Optimize hero media, server response and render-blocking resources.

cls.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
cls.detail: CLS measures visual stability. Reserve space for images/ads and avoid late-loaded UI that shifts content.

homepageHttpStatus.title: Homepage HTTP status
homepageHttpStatus.detailFail: Homepage returned HTTP {{status}}; fix this before optimizing SEO content.

serverResponseTime.title: Server response time
serverResponseTime.detailOk: Initial server response is within a healthy range.
serverResponseTime.detailSlow: Reduce redirects, server work and blocking upstream calls to improve the initial response.

htmlDownloadSize.title: Downloaded HTML size
htmlDownloadSize.detailLarge: HTML payload is large; reduce inline scripts, embedded data and unused markup.

titleTagLength.title: Title tag length
titleTagLength.detailPresent: Current title: "{{title}}". Aim for a descriptive title of 25–65 characters.
titleTagLength.detailMissing: Add a unique title tag naming brand, offer and primary search intent.

metaDescription.title: Meta description
metaDescription.detailPresent: Current meta description is {{count}} characters. Aim for 70–160.
metaDescription.detailMissing: Add a meta description summarizing the offer and giving searchers a reason to click.

h1Structure.title: H1 structure
h1Structure.detailMultiple: Use exactly one clear H1 on the homepage so search engines and visitors understand the page topic.

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.detailMissing: Add a canonical URL to prevent duplicate homepage variants competing in search.

structuredData.title: Structured data
structuredData.detailPresent: Structured data is present on the page.
structuredData.detailMissing: Add Organization, LocalBusiness, FAQ, Product or Review schema where relevant.

sitemapCheck.title: Sitemap check
sitemapCheck.detailMissing: Expose /sitemap.xml so search engines can find important pages faster.

https.title: HTTPS
https.detailHttp: Switch the registered URL to HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

mobileViewport.title: Mobile viewport
mobileViewport.detailMissing: Add a viewport meta tag so the page renders predictably on mobile devices.

imageAltText.title: Image alt text
imageAltText.detailNoImages: No images found in the fetched HTML.
imageAltText.detailMissing: Add descriptive alt text on important images and empty alt on decorative images.

socialPreview.title: Social media preview
socialPreview.detailComplete: Open Graph title and description are present.
socialPreview.detailIncomplete: Add Open Graph title and description so shared links display clearly in social channels.

googleBusinessConnection.title: Google Business connection
googleBusinessConnection.detailConnected: Google Business is connected so local brand signals can be compared with the website.
googleBusinessConnection.detailNotConnected: Connect Google Business to sync web content with maps, categories, hours and reviews.

reviewSources.title: Review sources
reviewSources.detailConnected: Review sources are connected and can inform trust messaging.
reviewSources.detailNotConnected: Connect Google Reviews or Tripadvisor to use real review themes in web optimization.

socialChannels.title: Social channels
socialChannels.detailConnected: Social channels are connected and can be compared with website messaging.
socialChannels.detailNotConnected: Connect active social profiles to compare brand positioning across channels.

paidMediaChannels.title: Paid media channels
paidMediaChannels.detailConnected: Paid channels are connected, useful for landing page and CTA alignment.
paidMediaChannels.detailNotConnected: Connect Google Ads or Meta Business before campaign-specific landing page optimization.
